# Top-line

```{r}
#| label: overview-topline-stats
#| output: false
#| include: false

# --- Data and Linkage Topline ---
new_notifications <- linelist |>
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff)

new_sequences <- seq_linelist |>
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff)

n_new_notifications <- nrow(new_notifications)
n_new_sequences <- nrow(new_sequences)

# --- Clustering Topline ---
n_new_sequences_in_clusters <- new_sequences %>%
  filter(cluster_size %in% c("Small", "Large")) %>%
  nrow()

n_new_clusters <- cluster_linelist %>%
  filter(cluster_size %in% c("Small", "Large")) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  filter(all(date_onset >= cutoff)) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop") %>%
  nrow()

n_new_recent_arrival <- new_sequences %>%
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff & recent_arrival == TRUE) %>%
  nrow()

n_new_recent_arrival_clustered <- new_sequences %>%
  filter(cluster_size %in% c("Small", "Large") & recent_arrival == TRUE) %>%
  nrow()

n_active_large_clusters <- new_sequences %>%
  filter(cluster_size == "Large") %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarise(n_active = any(date_onset >= cutoff)) %>%
  nrow()

# --- DRM Topline ---
n_insti_res <- class_resistance %>%
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff, class == "INSTI") %>%
  pull(resistant) %>%
  sum()

prep_drugs <- c("TDF", "FTC", "3TC")
n_prep_resistance <- drug_resistance %>%
  mutate(drug = ifelse(drug %in% c("FTC", "3TC"), "XTC", drug)) %>%
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff, drug %in% prep_drugs) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(compound_resistance = sum(resistant), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(compound_resistance >= 2) %>% # 2 or more of TDF, FTC, 3TC
  distinct(id) %>%
  nrow()

n_any_class_resistance <- class_resistance %>%
  filter(date_onset >= cutoff) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  filter(sum(resistant) >= 1) %>%
  distinct(id) %>%
  nrow()

# --- Location counts for map ---
location_counts <- new_notifications %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

location_cluster_rates <- new_sequences %>%
  filter(!is.na(location)) %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(
    n_sequences = n(),
    n_clustered = sum(cluster_size %in% c("Small", "Large")),
    pct_clustered = (100 * n_clustered / n_sequences),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ojs_define(
  locationCounts = location_counts,
  locationClusterRates = location_cluster_rates
)
```

```{r}
#| label: overview-fmt-cutoff
#| output: false
#| include: false

cutoff_pretty <- format(cutoff, '%d %b %Y')

```

```{r}
#| label: overview-conditional-colouring
#| output: false

color_insti <- if (n_insti_res > 0) "danger" else "secondary"
color_prep <- if (n_prep_resistance > 0) "danger" else "secondary"
```

```{r}
#| label: overview-fmt-pct
#| output: false
#| include: false

format_pct <- function(x, digits = 1) {
  paste0(round(x * 100, digits), "%")
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: overview-map
//| title: "New notifications by Location"

{
  const mapCounts = aq.table(locationCounts).objects()

  if (mapCounts.length === 0) {
    return noData("No data available.", {height: "200px"})
  }

  const maxCount = Math.max(...mapCounts.map(row => row.count), 1)
  const countsLookup = Object.fromEntries(
    mapCounts.map(row => [row.location, row.count])
  )

  const container = html`<div style="width:100%; height:100%; min-height:300px; position:relative"></div>`;
  yield container;
  await new Promise(r => new ResizeObserver((_, o) => { o.disconnect(); r(); }).observe(container));

  const map = L.map(container, {scrollWheelZoom: false})

  // .setView([-29, 145], 7); COMMENTED OUT WHILE TESTNG BOUND FIT

  L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png?key=" + cartoAPIKey,
      {
      attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap Contributors &copy; CARTO",
      maxZoom: 19
    }
  ).addTo(map)

  const geo = L.geoJSON(locationsGeo, {
    style: f => geoStyle(f, countsLookup, maxCount),
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      geoTooltip(f, layer, countsLookup);
      layer.on("click", () => map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {padding: [40, 40], maxZoom: 10}));
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  // Check for Locations with counts but not in GeoJSON
  const geoNames = new Set(locationsGeo.features.map(f => f.properties.name));
  const unmapped = Object.keys(countsLookup).filter(name => countsLookup[name] > 0 && !geoNames.has(name));

  if (unmapped.length > 0) {
    const unmappedLabels = unmapped.map(name => `${name} (${countsLookup[name]})`)
    const warning = L.control({position: "topright"})
    warning.onAdd = () => {
      const div = L.DomUtil.create("div")
      div.innerHTML = `
      <div style="background:#FFD200;color:#333;padding:0.5rem 0.75rem;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.8rem;box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.2);max-width:200px">
        <strong>⚠️ Not mapped:</strong> ${unmappedLabels.join(", ")}
      </div>`
      return div
    }
    warning.addTo(map)
  }

  // Handle Bounds: zoom to features with data; fall back to all locations.
  const withData = locationsGeo.features
    .filter(f => countsLookup[f.properties.name] > 0)

  const startBounds = withData.length > 0
    ? L.geoJSON(withData).getBounds()
    : L.geoJSON(
        locationsGeo.features.filter(f => f.properties.type === "location")
      ).getBounds()

  const reset = L.control({position: "topleft"})
  reset.onAdd = () => {
    const btn = L.DomUtil.create("button")
    btn.innerHTML = "Reset zoom"
    btn.style.cssText = "padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;background:white;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px"
    btn.onclick = (e) => {
      L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, {padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19})
    }
    return btn
  }
  reset.addTo(map)

  // Add legend
  gradientLegend(map, {max: maxCount, title: "Notifications"})

  let initialFitDone = false;
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (!initialFitDone && container.clientWidth > 100 && container.clientHeight > 100) {
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, {padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19});
      initialFitDone = true;
    }
  });
  ro.observe(container);
  invalidation.then(() => ro.disconnect());
}

```


```{ojs}
//| label: overview-map-clustered
//| title: "Percent clustered by Location"

{
  const rates = aq.table(locationClusterRates).objects()

  if (rates.length === 0) {
    return noData("No clustered sequence data available.", { height: "200px" })
  }

  const rateLookup = Object.fromEntries(
    rates.map(row => [row.location, row.pct_clustered])
  )

  const detailLookup = Object.fromEntries(
    rates.map(row => [row.location, row])
  )

  const container = html`<div style="width:100%; height:100%; min-height:300px; position:relative"></div>`
  yield container

  await new Promise(resolve => {
    new ResizeObserver((entries, observer) => {
      observer.disconnect()
      resolve(entries[0])
    }).observe(container)
  })

  const map = L.map(container, { scrollWheelZoom: false })

  L.tileLayer(
    "https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png?key=" + cartoAPIKey,
      {
      attribution: "&copy; OpenStreetMap Contributors &copy; CARTO",
      maxZoom: 19
    }
  ).addTo(map)

  const geo = L.geoJSON(locationsGeo, {
    style: feature => {
      const pct = rateLookup[feature.properties.name] || 0

      return {
        fillColor: fillColor(pct, 100),
        fillOpacity: 0.7,
        weight: 1,
        color: feature.properties.type === "state" ? "#999" : "#666"
      }
    },
    onEachFeature: (feature, layer) => {
      const location = feature.properties.name
      const detail = detailLookup[location]

      if (detail) {
        layer.bindTooltip(
          `${location}: ${detail.pct_clustered.toFixed(1)}% ` +
          `(${detail.n_clustered}/${detail.n_sequences})`
        )
      } else {
        layer.bindTooltip(`${location}: no new sequences`)
      }

      layer.on("click", () =>
        map.fitBounds(layer.getBounds(), {
          padding: [40, 40],
          maxZoom: 10
        })
      )
    }
  }).addTo(map)

  const withData = locationsGeo.features
    .filter(feature => rateLookup[feature.properties.name] > 0)

  const startBounds = withData.length > 0
    ? L.geoJSON(withData).getBounds()
    : L.geoJSON(
        locationsGeo.features.filter(feature => feature.properties.type === "location")
      ).getBounds()

  const reset = L.control({ position: "topleft" })

  reset.onAdd = () => {
    const button = L.DomUtil.create("button")
    button.textContent = "Reset zoom"
    button.style.cssText =
      "padding:4px 8px;cursor:pointer;background:white;" +
      "border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px"

    button.onclick = event => {
      L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(event)
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, { padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19 })
    }

    return button
  }

  reset.addTo(map)

  gradientLegend(map, {
    max: "100%",
    title: "Sequences in clusters"
  })

  let initialFitDone = false

  const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    map.invalidateSize()

    if (
      !initialFitDone &&
      container.clientWidth > 100 &&
      container.clientHeight > 100
    ) {
      map.fitBounds(startBounds, { padding: [20, 20], maxZoom: 19 })
      initialFitDone = true
    }
  })

  observer.observe(container)
  invalidation.then(() => observer.disconnect())
}
```
